ads.title: White, but never quiet.
ads.body:
White, but never quiet.

Featured in Tea Party for LUCY’S Magazine Vol. 86, our Structured Jacket Dress from MORPH I is styled as a contemporary sculptural top — where classic tailoring is pushed into something bolder, sharper, and more directional.

Defined by feather boning, architectural construction, and striking cut-outs, the piece blurs the line between garment and form.

A couture interpretation of modern power dressing.

The Copper Room by Flying Solo @flyingsolonyc @flyingsolo_pr
Producer: @lunkestyle
Photographer: @rquinterophoto
Talent/Model: @_palomasuarez @theindustryny
Wardrobe Stylist and Set Designer: @by.denise.milanez
HMUA: @i.no.u.e
Stylist Assistant: @julianagomes.stylist

#MannattGupta #LucysMagazine #MagazineCover #FashionArt #StructuredDress
